description: Code for "Reserves and trade jointly determine exposure to food supply shocks" is published by Marchand, Philippe; Carr, Joel A; Dell'Angelo, Jampel; Fader, Marianela; Gephart, Jessica A; Kummu, Matti; Magliocca, Nicholas R; Porkka, Miina; Puma, Michael J; Ratajczak, Zak; Rulli, Maria Cristina; Seekell, David A; Suweis, Samir; Tavoni, Alessandro; D'Odorico, Paolo. The R model propagates food-production shocks through trade networks and cereal reserves. Its stated coverage is Global cereal-production and trade network. Further dates and resolution are unknown unless specified by the provider. The provider exposes machine-readable metadata; data files were not downloaded. The inspected public resource is free to access. The licence is other-open. A paper-specific implementation using FAO and USDA inputs; continuing maintenance was not established. For simulation, it can inform food-supply demand, capacity or disruption scenarios; this is a reviewer assessment of potential use. Related record data-global-food-twin-food-flows provides a comparison in the same service area; technical compatibility was not tested.
